project.name: CE-POST-REMAP
project.objective: Finish the bounded dependency, runtime, CMake, documentation, harness, and validation work left after CE-REMAP without changing the validated architecture.

invariants.rule: Preserve frozen CE-ARCH and CE-LIVE contracts, numerical behavior, and current canonical physical ownership.
Cellerator runtime is the sole native runtime authority; compatibility runtime use is explicit and current core does not depend on it accidentally.
CellShard owns storage and neutral delivery metadata while Cellerator owns execution resources, collective policy, topology, scheduling, and Cellerator-specific placement.
Root CMake remains configuration-oriented, public targets and aliases remain stable unless proven unused, and CUDA targets do not consume module BMIs.
Authority documentation tells the post-remap truth, historical records remain historical, GlassHelix remains unfrozen, and canonical CE-LIVE harnesses require no temporary source edits.

Validation distinguishes regressions from environment limits, current native targets do not link CP-Math v1 evidence, the reverse CellShard runtime dependency is absent, and both repositories finish committed, pushed, and clean.

tasks.title: Eliminate the CellShard cycle and finish runtime and seam cleanup
tasks.objective: Consume the independently landed CellShard neutral distributed API, remove the Cellerator-to-CellShard-to-Cellerator runtime cycle, classify every legacy runtime consumer, migrate current core consumers that require only bounded adaptation, and keep genuine compatibility users explicitly scoped.
tasks.next_action: Verify the landed CellShard neutral API, classify all runtime and CellShard consumers, then perform only bounded current-core migrations.

tasks.title: Localize CMake ownership
tasks.objective: Move implementation, test, benchmark, example, and tool target definitions to sensible subsystem-local CMake files while preserving target names, aliases, options, and runtime behavior.
tasks.next_action: Move target definitions conservatively by source ownership and keep subsystem fan-in explicit.

tasks.title: Correct authoritative documentation and repair CE-LIVE harnesses
tasks.objective: Teach the post-remap repository map in authoritative documentation and make canonical CE-LIVE harnesses accept or discover the configured build and geometry locations without temporary patched copies.
tasks.next_action: Update stale authority documents and parameterize the canonical CE-LIVE harness paths.

tasks.title: Clean validation and workflow reconciliation
tasks.objective: Run fresh native, CelleraTorch, independent CellShard, integration, CE-LIVE, sanitizer, compatibility, layout, suffix, include, and dependency-graph validation; record exact evidence; reconcile the historical CE-REMAP run through authority; and leave both repositories clean.
tasks.next_action: Validate from fresh build directories, record exact graph and test evidence, then reconcile the historical CE-REMAP workflow state.

charter.objective: Complete only the bounded post-remap defects while preserving the canonical physical architecture and frozen execution semantics.
boundaries: No redesign of operation core, planner, execution image, geometry compiler, biological ABI, execution session, projection model, or CE-LIVE behavior.
No cellpack namespace rename and no speculative GlassHelix contract.
No CUDA rewrite and no module imports from CUDA translation units.
CellShard lands its reverse-dependency removal independently before Cellerator consumes it.
acceptance_conditions: Cellerator runtime is the sole current native runtime authority.
CMake ownership and authoritative documentation match the repository.
Canonical CE-LIVE harnesses and complete validation pass without temporary source substitutions.
